page.layout: One title page, centred: title lines at top, a flower-vase woodcut in the middle, imprint lines below. A library stamp at the right is not transcribed.
page.notes: Woodcut of a flower arrangement in a footed vase, in the centre of the page; no text. Circular library stamp at the right, not transcribed. Digitiser's watermark in the bottom right corner, not transcribed. The "V" in DISPUTATIO and NEMAUSENSI and NEMAUSI is printed as V; it is rendered as U because it stands for a vowel (see the rules on u/v). The name DAVIDE keeps its V as a consonant.
